question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**glad**" means feeling pleasure or happiness.
 
• In the context of the sentence, **"I thought he would be glad if I came upon him with his breakfast" **means that the person would be pleased or happy.
 
• The other options: "**most glad**", "**gladdest**", and "**more gladder**" are either incorrect forms or do not fit grammatically.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** I thought he would be glad__ if I came upon him with his breakfast, in that unexpected manner, so I went softly and touched him on the shoulder.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Most glad (सबसे खुश)**: This form is not commonly used in English.
 
• **Gladdest (सबसे ज्यादा खुश)**: This is a superlative form but not commonly used.
 
• **More gladder (ज्यादा खुश)**: This is grammatically incorrect.
